description: Extract a web page to clean Markdown + metadata (auto JS rendering, robots.txt respected). $0.005 fast / $0.01 rendered; cached results half price. payment_required.description: true when status is 402: body holds x402 payment terms, not a result. Pay and call again with x_payment
